evals.prompt: How should my coding agent ask Auto Ontology how many open orders we have?
evals.expected_output: If MCP is connected, use the handshake tools in order: check_readiness, search_terms, check_answerable, ask_question. Do not jump straight to ask_question. Do not copy a frozen tool table if the handshake list differs.
assertions: Prefers MCP when available
Sequences check_readiness before ask_question
Does not dump the full OpenAPI surface

evals.prompt: I'll POST questions to http://localhost:3001/api/chat/completions with a conversation_id from our partner app.
evals.expected_output: Do not expose or call FastAPI :3001 from a partner app. Public clients use the Next.js gateway on the web origin (:3000). FastAPI trusts x-auto-ontology-user-id and does not independently verify it. conversation_id on a direct FastAPI call requires that internal header.
assertions: Directs the caller to the Next.js gateway, not FastAPI :3001
Explains that FastAPI is a trusted internal boundary
Does not endorse public :3001 access

evals.prompt: As an authenticated user with chat:use and conversation:write, I send two overlapping POSTs to /api/chat/completions with the same conversation_id. What happens?
evals.expected_output: The second request returns 409 Conversation in progress. Wait for [DONE] on the SSE stream before sending the next turn. conversation_id is scoped to the authenticated Auto Ontology user.
assertions: Names 409 Conversation in progress
Requires waiting for [DONE] before the next turn
Does not recommend parallel turns on one conversation_id

evals.prompt: AI-Q already has the user's NVIDIA SSO JWT. Should it also mint an Auto Ontology API token to call chat?
evals.expected_output: No extra Auto Ontology token is required. Auto Ontology accepts the SSO id token as Authorization: Bearer, verifies issuer/signature/expiry, and does not check audience (aud is AI-Q's client id). The token must map to an existing Auto Ontology user (email, then SSO subject). An Auto Ontology API token is for scripts that cannot present SSO.
assertions: Uses the SSO bearer as the AI-Q credential
Does not require minting an Auto Ontology API token for AI-Q
Notes audience is not checked and an Auto Ontology user must already exist

evals.prompt: Which MCP tool lists every schema and column in the warehouse so I can write SQL myself?
evals.expected_output: There is none, on purpose. Consumers reach data through the semantic layer. describe_table is the table view (terms and SQL attributes). Use search_terms / ask_question rather than information_schema.
assertions: States there is no MCP catalog-browser for raw schemas
Points at describe_table / search_terms / ask_question
Does not recommend listing information_schema via Auto Ontology MCP

evals.prompt: Wire Auto Ontology to cuOpt so chat answers become a vehicle routing job.
evals.expected_output: This repository has no cuOpt bridge. Auto Ontology returns answers, SQL, and rows; a partner agent may feed numbers into cuOpt using cuopt-* skills. Do not claim Auto Ontology solves routing or LPs.
assertions: States there is no in-repo cuOpt integration
Allows a partner-wired hop from Auto Ontology rows to cuOpt
Does not invent an Auto Ontology routing API

evals.prompt: ask_question came back with an empty answer, no SQL, and no error. I'll rephrase the question.
evals.expected_output: Call check_readiness first. Empty answers are often a missing connection or uncompiled layer, not a phrasing problem. Rephrase only after readiness is clean, then search_terms.
assertions: Calls check_readiness (or compilation status) before rephrasing
Does not immediately retry a rephrased ask_question as the first step

evals.prompt: The question asks for unmet weekly demand in units. Generated SQL returns (1 - service_level) under the alias unmet_weekly_demand. Use that answer.
evals.expected_output: Reject the result as a material measure and unit substitution. One minus service level is a dimensionless share, not a quantity in units. Resolve the approved unmet-demand measure and source expression, regenerate or report the gap, and do not repair the error by relabeling the ratio.
assertions: Rejects the ratio-for-quantity substitution
Checks the approved measure expression and unit
Does not present the aliased ratio as demand units

evals.prompt: Use the nvidia-ontology-query skill to audit this query result before summarizing it. A query joins one row per run to 19 selected-job rows and reports SUM(risk_mwh). The source value is 7738.2 MWh and the result is 147025.8 MWh.
evals.expected_output: Do not summarize the multiplied value. The one-to-many join fanned out an already run-grain metric by 19. Require direct run-grain projection or isolation of the unique run row and preserve 7738.2 MWh.
assertions: Loads nvidia-ontology-query before auditing the result
Identifies one-to-many metric fanout
Rejects 147025.8 MWh as the run total
Requires a run-grain query before answering

evals.prompt: I asked for children of primary_material_shortage. The rows also include selective_prebuild_intervention whose parent is base. SQL executed successfully.
evals.expected_output: Execution success is insufficient. Reject the extra base-child row because the SQL omitted or substituted the requested parent/scenario predicate. Require explicit parent lineage, scenario, status, validity, and supersession filters before answering.
assertions: Rejects the wrong-parent population
Checks explicit lineage and validity predicates
Does not trim the extra row only in prose

evals.prompt: The SQL rows contain the requested values, but the answer only says that the query would compare the two runs. Is that a complete answer?
evals.expected_output: No. Validate the rows, then state the returned findings with values, units, scope, and status. Keep SQL/result correctness separate from answer-prose correctness; a query description is not a decision-ready answer.
assertions: Treats rows and answer prose as separate checks
Requires the prose to state actual findings
Preserves values, units, scope, and status

evals.prompt: The question requests forecast_runs.planning_artifact_sha256, but SQL selected a snapshot artifact-index hash with the same shape. Return it as the planning artifact.
evals.expected_output: Reject the substitution. Similar-looking hashes have different source roles. Require the requested table and column or report that the planning artifact is unavailable; do not relabel the snapshot index hash.
assertions: Checks the requested source role and column
Rejects the snapshot hash substitution
Does not repair provenance by changing the label

evals.prompt: ask_question returned 100 rows with row_count 340 and truncated true. List all 340 customers in rank order from this response.
evals.expected_output: The response cannot prove the complete list or ranking because 240 rows were withheld. Do not extrapolate or label the first 100 as complete. Narrow the request or obtain a bounded aggregate or complete authorized result before making the claim.
assertions: Treats truncated true as incomplete evidence
Does not claim a complete 340-row ranking
Narrows the request or asks for a complete supported result
